basics.description: **Infrastruktur CMDB** – IT configuration management database for sites, buildings, racks and network/compute infrastructure. Creates a web app and a PostgreSQL database (about 30 € per month). Passwords and keys are generated automatically.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Azure region for the CMDB, ideally close to your users.

basics.name: brandName
basics.label: Company name
basics.toolTip: Shown above the app name in the header, on the login page and in e-mails.

basics.name: appName
basics.label: Web address (optional)
basics.toolTip: Leave empty for an automatically generated address. Must be unique worldwide: 3–40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

constraints.validationMessage: 3–40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; must not start or end with a hyphen.

options.text: After the deployment (about 10–15 minutes) click Outputs and open the address shown as cmdbUrl. The first person who opens it creates the administrator account – so open it right away.
